title: a new compatibility shim, by its shape: an alias map, or x.new ?? x.oldName

explain.what: The code has the shape of a shim: a map from old names to new ones, or x.newKey ?? x.oldKey (x.new or x.old in Python, x.new.or(x.old) in Rust).
explain.why: An alias map or an old-key fallback keeps an old name working after a rename. It is tech debt: the old form never goes away (CLAUDE.md, No compatibility shims).
explain.fix: Change every caller and every stored file to the new name, and delete the map or the fallback.

js.message: a map from old names to new ones: change every caller and delete the old name
x.new ?? x.old reads an old key: migrate the data once and delete the old key

py.message: a map from old names to new ones: change every caller and delete the old name
x.new or x.old reads an old key: migrate the data once and delete the old key

rs.message: a map from old names to new ones: change every caller and delete the old name
x.new.or(x.old) reads an old key: migrate the data once and delete the old key
